shared_elements: circle with internal cross or spoked interior
elongated frontal body with head above torso
justification: Both depict a highly schematic frontal humanoid whose body is dominated by a circular motif — in A a ring/disc on the chest of a carved figure with a large blocky head, and in B a spoked or cross-filled circle set above/at the shoulders of a stick-limbed figure — plus a repeated linear band above (the row of ticks in B, the register of carved signs on A's head/cap). The correspondence is limited: A is a massive volumetric figure with a broad face, ears, arms folded on a rounded belly and additional carved emblems, whereas B is a pure linear outline figure with sinuous legs and no facial features, its circle occupying the head/upper-body position rather than being one of several body-borne emblems.
